```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 23, "setup_cost": 352, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "2": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 288, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 328, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "4": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 214, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "5": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 209, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "6": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 466, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "7": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 309, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "8": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 320, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "9": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 350, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 297, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "11": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 327, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "12": {"demand": 14, "setup_cost": 434, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "13": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 216, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "14": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 260, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "15": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 245, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 37, "2": 32, "3": 25, "4": 50, "5": 22, "6": 45, "7": 13, "8": 42,
    "9": 20, "10": 48, "11": 24, "12": 22, "13": 35, "14": 54, "15": 34
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Gesamtkosten minimieren
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfrage decken
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse
production_plan = {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe
import json
result = {"production": production_plan, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
